data.description: Use natural language to search photos
data.descriptionEn: Use natural language to search photos
data.descriptionZh: 基于自然语言搜索照片
data.readme:
· Find photos with a single sentence, e.g., "Find family group photos from last Spring Festival"
· Filter by time, location, person, pet, scene, screenshot, photo name, and format
· Clearly state when no photos are found, without fabricating results
data.readmeEn:
· Find photos with a single sentence, e.g., "Find family group photos from last Spring Festival"
· Filter by time, location, person, pet, scene, screenshot, photo name, and format
· Clearly state when no photos are found, without fabricating results
data.readmeZh:
· 支持用一句话找照片，例如“找去年春节的家庭合照”
· 可以按时间、地点、人物、宠物、场景、截图、照片名称和格式筛选
· 找不到照片时会直接说明，不会编造结果
